coverageToday.andEvenThoseArePartial: both say which half they prove in automation.coversPartially
coverageToday.why: Everything past the sign-in screen needs a bearer token built into the APK, which is a secret and is not in this repo. Those journeys report SKIPPED, never passed.

backendUnderTest.apiBaseUrl: http://localhost:8080/ - unreachable from a Test Lab device, by design
backendUnderTest.whyNotStgOrProd: stg points at the deployed stg API and prod points at api.goatos.mesha.sg, which is STG-backed PRODUCTION carrying real farm data. The priority journeys in this lane WRITE - proof upload, offline queue, retry, conflict, resume after force-stop. Running them against either would put automation writes into real farm records, which breaks the rule the whole design rests on: production is read-only and writes go to the OCI clone.
backendUnderTest.neverTheCloudBuildArtifact: Cloud Build ships a SIGNED RELEASE APK to Firebase App Distribution. It is the wrong artifact mechanically - instrumentation needs a debug build and a matching test APK - and it is a release flavour, so it points at a real backend. It is never used here.
backendUnderTest.enforcedBy: run-android-journeys.mjs refuses to submit any APK whose application id is not sg.mesha.goatos.dev, and refuses rather than guesses when the id cannot be read.
